firstPlayerRule: Choose a starting player by any method. The rules suggest the fiercest Viking roar, the hairiest beard, the most recent visit to Scandinavia, or drawing one shuffled crew member per player at random.
clarifications: The starting player receives one bonus victory point; proceeding clockwise, each subsequent player receives one more than the previous player.
